Data.subject: InfoComm and Media
Data.title: Telecommunication Penetration Rate, Monthly
Data.footnote: All figures for penetration rates are rounded to the nearest decimal point.  With effect from 1 Oct 2016, the Infocomm Development Authority and the Media Development Authority were restructured to form the Info-communications Media Development Authority and the Government Technology Agency of Singapore.

row.footnote: Mobile population penetration rate measures the total number of mobile subscriptions as a percentage of total population in Singapore.  Total population comprises Singapore residents and non-residents.  Total population (as at end June of each year) data from Singapore Department of Statistics are used in the denominator to compute data on 'Mobile Population Penetration Rate' up till May of the following year.  With effect from January 2001, IMDA has been using total population instead of resident population as the population base for the calculation of penetration rates for telecom services (unless otherwise stated).  Resident population was previously used because historically, the take-up of telecom services by non-resident population was typically low.  With the government's efforts in promoting foreign talent, the profile of the non-resident population have changed.  Specifically, there has been a marked increase in the subscription to telecom services by non-resident population.  Thus, to give a more accurate picture of the adoption of telecom services, it is appropriate to use total population data as the population base in the computation of penetration rates.

row.rowText: Residential Wired Broadband Household Penetration Rate
row.footnote: Prior to Nov 2024, Residential Wired Broadband Household Penetration Rate measures the total number of residential wired broadband subscriptions as a percentage of the total number of resident households in Singapore, and excludes all wireless access plans (provided via 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wi-Fi hotspots).  With effect from Nov 2024, Residential Wired Broadband Household Penetration Rate measures the total number of Residential Wired Broadband Subscriptions as a percentage of the total number of households in Singapore, and excludes all wireless access plans (provided via 4G/LTE, 5G, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wi-Fi hotspots).  The 'Total Households' figure will be updated by the Singapore Department of Statistics in Jun of each year, and will be used for computing 'Residential Wired Broadband Household Penetration Rate' up till May of the following year.  Please note that this does not necessarily reflect of the proportion of households with broadband in Singapore as some households subscribe to more than one broadband connection.  For a more accurate figure, please refer to IMDA's Household Survey findings.

Prior to Jan 2019, Wireless Broadband Population Penetration Rate measures the total number of retail wireless broadband Internet access subscriptions (i.e., for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) such as 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wi-Fi hotspots (including Wireless@SG subscriptions) as a percentage of the total population in Singapore.  With effect from Jan 2019, Wireless Broadband Population Penetration Rate measures the total number of retail wireless broadband Internet access subscriptions (i.e. for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) such as 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wireless@SG subscriptions as a percentage of the total population in Singapore.  Data for October 2022 was incomplete due to incomplete data returns from operators.  Data for October 2023 exclude one Wireless@SG Operators' figures due to server maintenance.  With effect from Nov 2024, Wireless Broadband Population Penetration Rate measures the total number of Wireless Broadband Subscriptions (i.e. for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) such as 4G/LTE, 5G, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wireless@SG subscriptions as a percentage of the total population in Singapore.  The 'Total Population' figure will be updated by the Singapore Department of Statistics in Jun of each year, and will be used for computing 'Wireless Broadband Population Penetration Rate' up till May of the following year.
